import outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations
import outputs.Proofs.RingmasterConvergence

namespace outputs.Theorems.RingmasterIterations
open OracleTemplate

noncomputable def budget : (let S := outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec; S.Params → Fin S.numOracles → ℕ) := fun p _ => ⌈8 * p.R * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε + 16 * p.σ ^ 2 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε ^ 2⌉₊

theorem result : Convergence outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec budget := by sorry
